title: ARS Sound Agent — Output (successAudioSpec | errorEnvelope)
description: Validates the polymorphic v1.0 output of the Sound Agent (Agent #11 of 17 — second faithful-EXECUTOR agent in the post tail, 11th defense-in-depth firewall pass over the passthrough VO transcript, third contractually mode-BLIND agent — the continued proof Ingest's mode-convergence seam holds THREE stages deep). Authored Day 79 (Tue Jul 7 2026) from SPEC §3 Outputs (Day 74 outline) + §6.3 9-code/slot-11 errorEnvelope mapping (Day 75 §6.3 LOCKED) + §10 Field Map + §10.4 schema authoring note (Day 75) + §12 deterministic AND-of-gates verdict math (Day 76) + §16 metadata block (Day 76) + the Day 78 LOCK CANDIDATE reconciliation. Polymorphism via top-level oneOf (mirrors AI Video Gen Day 14 + Style Replication Day 33 + QC Pre-flight Day 45 + Ingest Day 54 + Edit Director Day 62 + Editor Day 71 pattern — 7th reuse). DEFINING POSTURE — INHERITS Editor's two-verdict determinism: verdict enum is ['audio_ready','fail'] — exactly TWO values, NO 'revise' (the second fleet agent after Editor to carry only two verdicts). Sound is a fully-DETERMINISTIC executor (an asset resolves or it doesn't; a marker is in the timeline or it isn't; the loudness target is the platform const or it isn't; the VO transcript is byte-faithful or it isn't; the firewall is clean or it isn't), so there is NO subjective finish surface and NO held-creative-call verdict — the subjective slot stays ONE stage upstream at Edit Director's one 'revise'. successAudioSpec <=> verdict 'audio_ready'; errorEnvelope <=> verdict 'fail'. Human deferral lives in human_review_required const true + finish_target.finish_mode const 'human_in_the_loop' + finish_target.audio_processed const false on EVERY emission (recommend-don't-process), NOT in a verdict branch. The success branch encodes the §12 AND-of-gates HARD terms as const invariants (audio_conform_check all-booleans const true, spec_fidelity_check all-5-booleans const true, audio_firewall_pass_11 status const pass + hits const 0, loudness_target.primary const '-14 LUFS (IG/TT)' + true_peak_ceiling_dbtp const -1.0, finish_target.audio_processed const false + finish_mode const 'human_in_the_loop', mode_blind_confirm.production_mode_read const false) — making a false-audio-ready STRUCTURALLY impossible (false-audio-ready tolerance ZERO target, §8). 9 LOCKED failure codes (§6.3) + slot-11 catch-all sound_agent_failed enumerated via enum. DEFINING NAMESPACE DIVERGENCE: vo_track_missing and audio_asset_unresolved are each enumerated as a SEPARATE code (NOT folded — the deliberate OPPOSITE of Editor folding all resolution into one asset_unresolved) because the two Ingest-routed asset gaps carry distinct operator recovery diagnostics (re-confirm the VO voice track vs re-confirm the music bed — D8); spec_fidelity_breach is kept FOLDED (hash-tamper + duration mismatch + mix-directive/VO deviation, all route back to Editor). audio_processed const false (Hard Rule #3/#12 — authors an audio spec, processes no waveform; the human mixes in v1.0; Week 4-5 DSP automation is v1.1). audio_spec_evidence_hash + edl_evidence_hash pattern ^[a-f0-9]{64}$. asset_uri ^ars:// platform-relative (Hard Rule inherit). human_review_required const true on EVERY branch (recommend-don't-process — Hard Rule #13). QUINTUPLY-DEFERRED (Decision D7): parent_chain held additively (minItems 5, prefixItems 0-9, maxItems 10, items false) — accepts the 5-tuple, the 6-tuple QC extension preview, the 7-tuple Ingest extension preview, the 8-tuple Edit Director extension preview, the 9-tuple Editor extension preview, AND the 10-tuple Sound append. TODO@cross-spec-3.9-ratification: flip to minItems 10 (exact-10) ONLY after the Cross-SPEC §3.9 n-tuple amendment ratifies AND the Editor 9-tuple LOCKs AND the Edit Director 8-tuple LOCKs AND the Ingest 7-tuple LOCKs AND the QC Pre-flight 6-tuple LOCKs. The 10-tuple is the one item NOT auto-advanced this run (Sound is the FIFTH forcing function for the amendment).

successAudioSpec.description: verdict == 'audio_ready' branch (§3.1) — the ONLY success verdict (NO 'revise'; inherits Editor's deterministic two-verdict posture). Emitted ONLY when every HARD AND-of-gate term is true (§12 deterministic AND-of-gates, zero tunable thresholds): Editor precondition met AND edl_evidence_hash verified AND the VO voice track resolved AND the music bed resolved AND all mix/SFX/duck markers in the timeline AND the loudness target is the platform const AND the audio timeline duration matches the EDL AND the VO transcript byte-faithful AND the 11th-pass audio-domain firewall clean (hits==0). The hard-gate terms are schema-pinned as consts below, so a false-audio-ready (a clean envelope alongside a failing hard sub-status) is STRUCTURALLY impossible (false-audio-ready tolerance ZERO). human_review_required is const true even on audio_ready (an audio_ready = 'ready for the human's finish-into-v2 decision', NEVER 'mixed' or 'approved' — Hard Rule #13). Any HARD defect routes to the errorEnvelope branch instead (verdict 'fail').

verdict.description: The ONLY success verdict. NO 'revise' (the executor is deterministic — inherits Editor's posture). The two-verdict enum ['audio_ready','fail'] manifests across the two oneOf branches.

audio_spec.description: §10 — the canonical audio conform spec (the buildable, highest-leverage $0 slice — D1). loudness_target + vo_polish + music_bed mix + duck_envelope + sfx_accents + the byte-faithful vo_transcript passthrough. This is a DECLARED spec — level targets, duck-dB, SFX placement — NOT applied DSP (finish_target.audio_processed const false). The human (or the Week 4-5 automation) runs the mix + loudness pass into the v2.mp4.

loudness_target.description: §10 — the platform loudness spec (D14: single -14 LUFS master in v1.0; the -16 LUFS YT variant flagged + deferred). primary const '-14 LUFS (IG/TT)' + true_peak_ceiling_dbtp const -1.0 (zero-tolerance — a deviation => loudness_target_out_of_spec, route Editor). The target is a DECLARED conform goal, NOT a measured value (no LUFS measurement in v1.0 — no decode, Hard Rule #12).

primary.description: const platform loudness target for IG/TikTok in v1.0 (a deviation => loudness_target_out_of_spec).

true_peak_ceiling_dbtp.description: const -1.0 dBTP true-peak ceiling (a deviation => loudness_target_out_of_spec).

vo_polish.description: §10 — the VO polish directives authored to the brand voice cadence (declared spec, not applied DSP). Absent / empty on a music-only reel (no resolved VO track).

music_bed.description: §10 — the music-bed mix directive bound to the resolved bed. asset_uri passthrough from edl.music_event (must have resolved against asset_bundle.music_bed); at_ms const 0 (bed at t0); base_level_db + duck_under_vo_db the declared mix levels.

at_ms.description: The bed lays at t0 (faithful to the EDL music_event).

duck_envelope.description: §10 — the duck moves covering the VO spans, with swell moves mapped byte-position-faithful from the EDL music_swell_map (spec_fidelity_check.swell_markers_match_edl). Each from_ms/to_ms MUST be inside the timeline (from_ms >= 0, to_ms <= total_timeline_ms — else audio_marker_out_of_range).

sfx_accents.description: §10 — the SFX accents. Each at_ms MUST be inside the timeline (0 <= at_ms <= total_timeline_ms — else audio_marker_out_of_range).

vo_transcript.description: §10 — the Script/Editor-authored VO transcript, PASSTHROUGH byte-faithful (Hard Rule #10 — Sound authors no spoken copy; a deviation => spec_fidelity_breach). Also the 11th-firewall scan surface.

edl_precondition_check.description: §10 — the precondition evidence (Step 1 / Checks #1+#2). edl_id is the finished EDL; verdict_observed == 'edl_ready' OR lever3_signoff_present == true was required to proceed (else the run halted upstream_edl_not_ready).

audio_conform_check.description: §10 — the audio-conform adjudication (Steps 3-4,9 / Checks #3-#5). ALL booleans const true on the success branch (gate terms): any false routes to the errorEnvelope (vo_track_missing / audio_asset_unresolved / audio_marker_out_of_range / loudness_target_out_of_spec). duration_in_band == (45000 <= total_timeline_ms <= 75000), const true on success.

vo_track_resolved.description: const true on success. false => vo_track_missing (errorEnvelope, route Ingest — SPLIT code).

music_bed_resolved.description: const true on success. false => audio_asset_unresolved (errorEnvelope, route Ingest — SPLIT code).

all_markers_in_timeline.description: const true on success. false => audio_marker_out_of_range (errorEnvelope, route Editor).

loudness_target_in_spec.description: const true on success. false => loudness_target_out_of_spec (errorEnvelope, route Editor).

total_timeline_ms.description: The audio timeline runtime; equals the EDL total_timeline_ms on success (a mismatch => spec_fidelity_breach).

spec_fidelity_check.description: §10 — the faithful-finish invariant (Steps 3,9 / Check #6). ALL 5 booleans const true on the success branch (gate terms): any false => spec_fidelity_breach (errorEnvelope, route Editor). This is the structural proof Sound RE-CUT NOTHING (Hard Rule #2) — the music event + swell markers + timeline duration match the EDL byte-position-faithful, the VO transcript is byte-faithful, and the EDL anchor re-verifies.

vo_transcript_byte_faithful.description: const true on success. false => spec_fidelity_breach (route Editor).

edl_evidence_hash_verified.description: const true on success. false (tamper) => spec_fidelity_breach (route Editor).

audio_firewall_pass_11.description: §10 — the 11th-pass firewall result over the passthrough VO transcript (the spoken-word surface Editor's 10th commit-text pass does not cover — the last audio checkpoint before Motion typography, Step 8 / Check #8). hits MUST be 0 on the success branch (gate term); any hit => audio_firewall_breach (errorEnvelope, route Editor — the GATING §9 TC-05 case). passthrough_transcript_fields_scanned = the true VO-transcript-field census.

tier_richness_echo.description: OPTIONAL §10 — the echoed planned loudness-variant count. v1.0 specs ONLY the primary -14 LUFS master (loudness_variants_specced const 1; the -16 LUFS YT variant reserved v1.1+, flagged). Echo only, NOT a spec of the variants.

loudness_variants_specced.description: const 1 in v1.0 — the primary -14 LUFS master only.

variant_masters.description: RESERVED v1.1+ (§16 D14) — the auto-specced loudness-variant masters (the -16 LUFS YT variant, etc.). Empty / absent in v1.0 (a variant master is a derived re-spec, lower-leverage than the primary).

human_review_required.description: const true even on audio_ready — an audio_ready is 'ready for the human's finish-into-v2 decision', NEVER 'mixed'/'approved' (Hard Rule #13 — recommend-don't-process).

errorEnvelope.description: verdict == 'fail' branch (§3.2). The §6.3 LOCKED namespace: 9 substantive codes + slot-11 catch-all sound_agent_failed. vo_track_missing and audio_asset_unresolved are each a SEPARATE code (the deliberate OPPOSITE of Editor folding all resolution into one asset_unresolved) — the two Ingest-routed asset gaps carry distinct operator recovery diagnostics (D8). spec_fidelity_breach is FOLDED (hash-tamper + duration mismatch + mix-directive/VO deviation — all route to Editor). NO 'revise' here — Sound has no third verdict. human_review_required const true.

failure_code.description: The §6.3 LOCKED namespace: 9 substantive codes + slot-11 catch-all sound_agent_failed (Cross-SPEC §3.6). vo_track_missing + audio_asset_unresolved are kept SPLIT (distinct Ingest recovery diagnostics — the OPPOSITE of Editor's single folded asset_unresolved, D8); spec_fidelity_breach is FOLDED (hash-tamper + duration + mix-directive/VO deviation route to Editor). audio_lineage_failure = forensic halt (Check #10). sound_agent_failed accompanies attempts==2 (self-QC 2-strike exhaustion). NO 'revise' — Sound is two-verdict.

failed_check_id.description: Which §6.1 self-QC check produced the verdict (1..11 — the 11-check list, bipartite-covering the 9 codes + slot-11).

attempts.description: Self-QC 2-strike ceiling (§6 retry policy). attempts==2 accompanies sound_agent_failed (slot-11). No third attempt.

route_back_to.description: §3.2 / §12.2 verdict<->route map. ingest-agent on an asset-resolution gap (vo_track_missing — the VO voice track; audio_asset_unresolved — the music bed); editor-agent on a finish-vs-EDL defect needing a re-cut/re-conform (audio_marker_out_of_range, loudness_target_out_of_spec, spec_fidelity_breach, audio_firewall_breach — the timeline/committed surface is Editor's, so the defect/leak routes to the conformer); null on a halt that no upstream is at fault for (the precondition halts upstream_edl_not_ready + upstream_not_success, the forensic audio_lineage_failure, and slot-11 sound_agent_failed — the agent's own self-QC failure).

detail.description: Free-form failure context (the specific violation, affected markers, recovery_path, upstream_failure, the unresolved VO track on a vo_track_missing, the unresolvable bed on an audio_asset_unresolved, the offending marker + timeline bound on an audio_marker_out_of_range, the out-of-spec target on a loudness_target_out_of_spec, the leaking VO transcript field + banned token on an audio_firewall_breach, etc.). Advisory recovery_path is surfaced, NOT auto-executed (v1.0 routes; it does not re-finish).

modeBlindConfirm.description: Root-level mode-blind self-attestation (§16 companion — NOT in metadata). Sound is the THIRD contractually mode-blind agent — the proof Ingest's convergence seam holds THREE stages deep (Edit Director -> Editor -> Sound). production_mode_read const false (Hard Rule #7); consumed const 'mode_agnostic_edl'.

finishTarget.description: Root-level finish-target self-attestation (§16 companion — NOT in metadata). The machine-checkable no-DSP / human-in-the-loop guarantee at the audio-executor seam (the direct analog of Editor's render_target block — v1.0 keeps audio_processed false). audio_processed const false (Hard Rule #3/#12); finish_mode const 'human_in_the_loop'; v2_edit_uri reserved (the human writes the v2.mp4 path on finish — active write deferred to v1.1 Week 4-5 DSP automation).

audio_processed.description: const false in v1.0 — Sound authors an audio spec, touches no waveform (no DSP, no LUFS measurement, no decode); the human mixes (Hard Rule #3/#12). An audio spec claiming a processed waveform it never touched is forged provenance. Automation is v1.1.

finish_mode.description: const 'human_in_the_loop' in v1.0; 'automated' reserved v1.1 Week 4-5.

v2_edit_uri.description: RESERVED v1.0 (null/placeholder — the human writes the v2.mp4 here on finish). Populated as a real render handle only when Week 4-5 DSP automation ships (v1.1).

handoffTargets.description: §7 Step 10 — the downstream handoff. v1.0 = ['motion-agent'] (Sound hands the finalized-audio v2 edit to Motion #12 for typography). D15 (PRELIMINARY): Motion does not exist yet, so the handoff target is drafted to the Drive conform-queue holding store to prevent an audit-trail break; operator ratifies at the Day 78 LOCK walk.

reelRefFull.description: §10 — the derived reel reference triple (the cross-record audit join keys). audio_spec_id is this agent's emitted identity.

reelRefMinimal.description: Minimal reel reference on the errorEnvelope branch (§3.2) — at minimum the emitting agent's own identity.

edlId.description: Editor's emitted identity (UUIDv7 per Cross-SPEC §3.9 ID canon) — the consumed EDL + parent_chain[8] (the 9-tuple element). UUIDv7 validates under the uuid format.

audioSpecId.description: This agent's emitted identity (UUIDv7 per Cross-SPEC §3.9 ID canon) — also appended at parent_chain[9] (the 10-tuple extension, held additively). UUIDv7 validates under the uuid format.

preflightReportId.description: QC Pre-flight's emitted identity + the 6th parent_chain element. v1.0: ^preflight-REINVENTED-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN$ (multi-brand v1.1+ widens the prefix).

qcPreFlagsEmitted.description: Sound's own emitted predicates (§3.7 snake_case, >=4 — Check #11). e.g. loudness_target_in_spec, vo_track_resolved, audio_firewall_clean_pass_11, mode_blind_finished. Appended to the upstream union without modifying it (§10.3).

sessionId.description: Accepts Cross-SPEC §3.9 UUID(-v7) canon OR the established ars-/sess- prefixed forms (additive, backward-compatible). Single combined pattern avoids oneOf/format ambiguity (format is annotation-only under Draft 2020-12 default assertion behavior).

parentChainHeld.description: QUINTUPLY-DEFERRED (Decision D7 / §10.4 / §16 addition 1). The 10-tuple, HELD ADDITIVELY: prefixItems positions 0-9 = [brief_id, script_id, storyboard_id, production_plan_id|rendered_shots_set_id|mode-c-direct, replication_set_id, preflight_report_id, asset_manifest_id, edit_plan_id, edl_id, audio_spec_id]. minItems 5 ACCEPTS the 5-tuple inbound canon (pre-ratification); maxItems 10 ACCEPTS the 6-tuple QC extension preview, the 7-tuple Ingest extension preview, the 8-tuple Edit Director extension preview, the 9-tuple Editor extension preview, AND the 10-tuple Sound append; items false. REJECTS a 4-tuple. positions 0-8 inherit the Editor parentChainHeld verbatim; position 9 is Sound's append (audio_spec_id, UUIDv7). This is the one item NOT auto-advanced this run (Sound is the FIFTH forcing function for the amendment).

metadataBlock.description: Cross-SPEC §3.9 canonical block + 6 Sound additions (§16): audio_spec_class, audio_spec_evidence_hash, audio_processed (const false), finish_mode (const human_in_the_loop), runtime_environment_class, audio_spec_id. human_review_required const true (Hard Rule #13). audio_processed const false is the declared-no-DSP honesty contract — an audio spec CLAIMING a mix it never processed is forged provenance (Hard Rule #3/#12). production_mode is PRESENT for audit lineage but the sibling root-level mode_blind_confirm attests it was never READ (Hard Rule #7).

production_mode.description: PRESENT for audit lineage; NOT read as a branch (Hard Rule #7). The sibling root-level mode_blind_confirm.production_mode_read:false attests it was never consulted.

cost_incurred_usd.description: ~$0 — finish reasoning + audio-spec authoring only (Cross-SPEC §3.9). $0 engine + $0 DSP + $0 decode + $0 LUFS-measurement invariant (ties Ingest / QC Pre-flight / Edit Director / Editor for lightest in the fleet).

latency_ms.description: Reasoning-only; target p50 <= 22000 / p95 <= 70000 (§8 — lighter than Editor's authoring; ties Ingest for a resolution-only surface).

audio_spec_class.description: Addition 1. v1.0 = primary_master_-14lufs; variant_master_-16lufs reserved v1.1+ (§16 / D14).

audio_spec_evidence_hash.description: Addition 2. SHA-256 (lowercase hex, 64) over the audio_spec + audio_conform_check + spec_fidelity_check block (§6.1 #11 / §3.2). Tamper-evident finish; the audit anchor + recomputability basis for recommend-don't-process.

audio_processed.description: Addition 3. const false in v1.0 — the declared-no-DSP honesty contract (Hard Rule #3/#12). Sound authors an audio spec, processes no waveform; the human mixes. Mirrors the root-level finish_target.audio_processed.

finish_mode.description: Addition 4. const-equivalent ['human_in_the_loop'] in v1.0; 'automated' reserved v1.1 Week 4-5. Mirrors the root-level finish_target.finish_mode.

runtime_environment_class.description: Addition 5. Inherited from AI Video Gen §16.

audio_spec_id.description: Addition 6. This agent's emitted identity (UUIDv7) — mirrors reel_ref.audio_spec_id and parent_chain[9].
